Snip Studio video filmstrip - technical reference credit

The WinForms filmstrip UI and the extension of Snip Studio's existing Windows
Media Foundation backend are original Snip Studio implementation. Microsoft's
VideoThumbnail sample was consulted as a technical reference for thumbnail
seeking and decoding; this credit does not describe copied or adapted code.

Reference: Microsoft Windows classic samples - VideoThumbnail
